name: Court ruling or judicial decision

primary_sources.name: Opinion / order
primary_sources.note: PDF is the authoritative format; extract text and pin both

primary_sources.name: Oral argument transcript
primary_sources.note: Only for appellate courts; not always available before ruling

primary_sources.name: Underlying statute or regulation
primary_sources.note: Pin the specific provision the ruling interprets

computations.description: Parse the vote from the opinion (e.g. 6-3, per curiam, unanimous) and identify who joined which opinion
Trace the case path: district court ruling, circuit court ruling, cert grant, oral argument, decision

outlet_check.method: Compare each outlet's characterization of the holding against the opinion's actual language
outlet_check.rule: Legal holdings are precise; check whether the outlet's summary captures the actual scope of the ruling or broadens/narrows it

sections.note: Key passages from majority and dissent, quoted
Procedural timeline if the case has a significant path

grok_scope.constraint: Named parties only, from court docket or PACER, with filing dates
grok_scope.example: Search for amicus briefs filed in [case name] [docket number]

grok_scope.constraint: Official statements from named parties or counsel, dated, with source URLs
grok_scope.example: Search for [party name] statement on [case name] ruling

subject_page_updates: Court rulings may not have a standing subject page unless they are part of a series (e.g. abortion rights, immigration enforcement)
If a subject page exists, append the new ruling to its timeline
